allow.description: The decision. Omitted is a DENY: an empty body has not made a decision.

reason.description: Optional human sentence, written to the node's rejection log line. It is not carried on stream.publish_rejected, whose reason is the closed value hook_denied.

patch.description: Optional per-stream config patch: the PATCH /v1/streams/{id} body (StreamSpec), unknown fields refused. Applied on the allow decision, before the session starts; on a stream with no row it provisions one, so labels and relays here are in force from the first session and every later one. A patch that does not apply is logged and never fails the publish.
